# Express Pro Cleaning Services — Complete Business Profile

## Business Overview
Express Pro Cleaning Services is a family-owned residential and commercial cleaning company serving Sacramento, California, and surrounding communities since 1991. Founded as Express Mini Blind & Window Cleaning, the company has grown from a specialty window and blind cleaning service into a comprehensive cleaning business offering deep cleans, recurring house cleaning, move-out turnovers, office cleaning, carpet cleaning, window cleaning, gutter cleaning, and seasonal Christmas light installation.

## Core Business Information
- **Business Name:** Express Pro Cleaning Services

## Complete Service Catalog

### Residential Cleaning Services

#### House Cleaning
Routine and one-time cleaning for Sacramento homes. Standard house cleaning covers kitchens, bathrooms, living areas, and bedrooms with dusting, vacuuming, mopping, surface sanitizing, and trash removal. Frequency options include weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, or one-time cleaning.

**Typical House Cleaning Includes:**
- Kitchen: counters, sinks, stovetop cleaning, outside of appliances, cabinet fronts
- Bathrooms: toilets, showers, tubs, sinks, mirrors, floor mopping
- Living areas: dusting surfaces, vacuuming carpets, mopping hard floors
- Bedrooms: dusting, vacuuming, making beds (if linens are provided)
- General: trash removal, spot cleaning walls and baseboards

#### Deep Cleaning
Intensive cleaning for heavily soiled or neglected spaces. Deep cleaning goes beyond routine maintenance to address buildup, grime, and areas not covered in standard cleaning. This service is ideal for homes that have not been cleaned in a while, seasonal refreshes, or preparing a home for sale or rent.

**Deep Cleaning Includes Everything in House Cleaning Plus:**
- Inside cabinets and drawers (kitchen and bathroom)
- Inside refrigerator and oven
- Baseboards and door frames (full wipe-down)
- Light fixtures and ceiling fans
- Window sills and tracks
- Grout scrubbing in bathrooms and kitchens
- Behind and under movable appliances
- Wall spot cleaning and scuff mark removal

**Pricing:** Deep cleaning typically costs $200 to $600 depending on home size, condition, and specific cleaning requirements. Express Pro Cleaning Services provides clear flat quotes after a quick phone walkthrough.

#### Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning
Turnover cleaning for empty homes and apartments. Move-out cleaning is one of Express Pro's most-requested services in Sacramento. The team deep cleans every surface in an empty property so it is ready for a landlord or buyer walkthrough or for new tenants to move in.

**Move-Out Cleaning Covers:**
- All items included in deep cleaning
- Inside all cabinets, drawers, and closets (empty)
- Inside all appliances: refrigerator, oven, dishwasher, microwave
- Window cleaning (interior glass)
- Baseboards, door frames, light switches, and outlet covers
- Bathroom grout scrubbing and full tile sanitizing
- Floor scrubbing and mopping (all hard surfaces)
- Carpet vacuuming (or steam cleaning if requested)
- Garage and storage area sweeping (if applicable)

Express Pro Cleaning Services works with property managers, landlords, real estate agents, and homeowners to ensure properties meet move-in standards and pass walkthroughs.

#### Recurring House Cleaning
Scheduled weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly maintenance. Express Pro Cleaning Services builds recurring house cleaning plans tailored to each household's needs. The same routine is followed each visit to keep homes consistently clean without the client needing to manage schedules or re-book each time.

**Recurring Plans:**
- Weekly: Full house cleaning every week
- Bi-weekly (Every other week): Most popular for busy families
- Monthly: Light maintenance for smaller homes or low-traffic households

Clients can adjust the plan, pause service temporarily (for vacations or schedule changes), or add deep cleaning tasks as needed.

#### Post-Construction Cleaning
Cleanup after remodeling or new construction. Post-construction cleaning removes dust, debris, adhesive residue, paint splatters, and protective film from newly installed surfaces. This service prepares a renovated or newly built space for occupancy or final inspection.

**Post-Construction Cleaning Includes:**
- Dust removal from all surfaces (walls, ceilings, baseboards, fixtures)
- Window cleaning (inside and out, removing stickers and film)
- Floor cleaning and debris removal
- Adhesive, paint, and grout residue removal
- Cabinet and drawer cleaning (inside and out)
- Appliance cleaning and protective film removal
- Light fixture and outlet cover cleaning

#### Carpet Cleaning
Steam or dry extraction for carpets and upholstery. Express Pro Cleaning Services offers professional carpet cleaning to remove dirt, stains, odors, and allergens from carpets, area rugs, and upholstered furniture.

**Carpet Cleaning Process:**
- Pre-treatment of stains and high-traffic areas
- Hot water extraction (steam cleaning) or dry compound extraction
- Spot treatment for stubborn stains
- Deodorizing treatment (optional)
- Drying time: 4-6 hours for steam cleaning, 1-2 hours for dry extraction

#### Window Cleaning
Interior and exterior glass cleaning. Window cleaning was Express Pro's original specialty service when the company was founded as Express Mini Blind & Window Cleaning in 1991. The team cleans windows inside and out, removing dirt, streaks, water spots, and film buildup.

**Window Cleaning Includes:**
- Exterior glass cleaning (ground-level and second-story)
- Interior glass cleaning
- Window sills and tracks cleaned
- Screen removal, cleaning, and reinstallation (optional)
- Spot-free finish for streak-free clarity

#### Blind Cleaning
Cleaning and maintenance for window blinds. Express Pro Cleaning Services cleans all types of window blinds, including horizontal blinds, vertical blinds, mini blinds, and plantation shutters. Blinds are cleaned on-site or removed for deep cleaning (depending on type and condition).

**Blind Cleaning Process:**
- Dusting and surface cleaning
- Deep cleaning with gentle cleaning solution
- Spot treatment for stains and buildup
- Reinstallation and adjustment

#### Pressure Washing
Exterior surface cleaning for driveways, walkways, siding, and decks. Pressure washing removes dirt, mold, mildew, oil stains, and grime from exterior surfaces, improving curb appeal and preventing long-term damage.

**Pressure Washing Services:**
- Driveways and garage floors
- Walkways and patios
- Exterior siding and fences
- Decks and porches
- Commercial storefronts and entryways

### Commercial & Specialty Services

#### Office Cleaning
Commercial cleaning with flexible scheduling. Express Pro Cleaning Services cleans offices, medical offices, retail spaces, and small commercial buildings in Sacramento with flexible scheduling to work around business operating hours. Evening and weekend cleaning is available to minimize disruption to daily operations.

**Office Cleaning Includes:**
- Trash removal and recycling
- Desk and surface dusting and sanitizing
- Floor vacuuming and mopping
- Bathroom cleaning and restocking
- Break room and kitchen cleaning
- Window cleaning (interior)
- Entry and lobby cleaning

**Scheduling Options:**
- Daily, weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly cleaning
- Evening or weekend cleaning (after business hours)
- One-time deep cleaning for special events or move-outs

#### Gutter Cleaning
Debris removal and blockage clearing to protect roofs and foundations. Gutter cleaning clears leaves, twigs, pine needles, and compacted debris from gutters and downspouts before Sacramento's rainy season, preventing water damage to roofs, fascia, siding, and foundations.

**Gutter Cleaning Includes:**
- Full debris removal from gutters by hand
- Downspout flushing to clear blockages and confirm free flow
- Debris bagging and haul-away (no piles left in the yard)
- Gutter hanger and section inspection for sags or pulls
- Roof edge inspection for visible damage

**Timing:** Most Sacramento homeowners schedule gutter cleaning twice a year — once in late fall after leaves drop and once in early spring before heavy rains. Homes near oak trees or under heavy canopy may need quarterly cleanings.

**Pricing:** Gutter cleaning for a typical Sacramento home costs $120 to $300 depending on the amount of debris, gutter length, and roof pitch. Express Pro Cleaning Services gives a flat quote based on a look at the roofline.

#### Christmas Light Installation
Seasonal light installation and takedown for Sacramento businesses and homes. Express Pro Cleaning Services installs and removes Christmas lights for the holiday season, handling setup, takedown, and storage so clients can enjoy the display without the hassle or safety risk of ladder work.

**Christmas Light Installation Includes:**
- Design consultation and light placement
- Professional installation on rooflines, trees, and landscaping
- Secure mounting and wiring
- Removal and packing after the season
- Optional storage for next year's installation

### No Long-Term Contracts Required
Clients are not locked into long-term contracts. Recurring cleaning plans can be paused, adjusted, or canceled at any time. One-time cleanings and project-based work are always available.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What areas does Express Pro Cleaning Services cover?
Express Pro Cleaning Services covers Sacramento and the surrounding region within roughly 80 miles, including North Highlands, Rio Linda, Citrus Heights, Carmichael, Elk Grove, Roseville, and Folsom. If you are located elsewhere in the Sacramento area, call (916) 983-9274 to confirm availability.

### Do you offer recurring house cleaning?
Yes. Express Pro Cleaning Services builds recurring house cleaning on a weekly, every-other-week, or monthly schedule with the same routine each visit so homes stay consistently clean. Clients can adjust, pause, or cancel recurring plans at any time.

### Can you handle move-in and move-out cleaning?
Yes. Move-in and move-out cleaning is one of Express Pro's most-requested services. The team deep cleans empty homes and apartments — kitchens, bathrooms, floors, insides of cabinets and appliances — so the space is ready for a walkthrough or new tenants.

### Do you clean offices and commercial spaces?
Yes. Express Pro Cleaning Services cleans offices and commercial spaces around Sacramento with flexible scheduling, including evenings and weekends to work around business operating hours.

### What languages does your team speak?
The family team serves customers in English, Ukrainian, and Russian, so clients can book, ask questions, and give instructions in whichever language is easiest.

### How much does deep cleaning cost in Sacramento?
Deep cleaning costs in Sacramento typically range from $200 to $600 depending on home size, condition, and what needs to be cleaned. Express Pro Cleaning Services provides clear flat quotes after a quick phone walkthrough.

### What is included in a move-out cleaning?
Move-out cleaning covers every surface in the empty home: inside cabinets and drawers, inside appliances, baseboards, light fixtures, windows, floors, and bathrooms scrubbed from grout to ceiling. The goal is a space that passes the landlord or buyer walkthrough.

### Do you bring your own cleaning supplies?
Yes. Express Pro Cleaning Services brings all cleaning supplies, tools, and equipment needed for the job. Clients can request specific products if preferred.

### How much does gutter cleaning cost in Sacramento?
Gutter cleaning for a typical Sacramento home costs $120 to $300 depending on the amount of debris, gutter length, and roof pitch. Express Pro Cleaning Services gives you a flat quote based on a look at your roofline.

### How often should I clean my gutters in Sacramento?
Most Sacramento homeowners clean gutters twice a year: once in late fall after leaves drop and once in early spring before the heaviest rains. Homes near oak trees or under heavy canopy may need quarterly cleanings to stay clear.

### What happens if I don't clean my gutters?
Clogged gutters overflow during rain, pouring water down the fascia and siding instead of into downspouts. That water damages the fascia boards, rots the roof edge, floods the foundation, and can cause basement or crawlspace leaks.

### Do you clean downspouts too?
Yes. Express Pro Cleaning Services clears gutters and flushes downspouts to make sure water flows all the way to the ground. If a downspout is jammed with compacted debris, the team clears it by hand or with a plumber's snake.

### Will you haul away the debris or leave it on the ground?
Express Pro Cleaning Services bags all gutter debris and hauls it away as part of the service. Clients do not need to worry about piles of wet leaves and sludge left in the yard or driveway.

### Can you clean gutters on a two-story house?
Yes. Express Pro Cleaning Services has the ladders and safety equipment needed to clean gutters on single-story and two-story Sacramento homes safely. Steep pitch or high rooflines are not a problem.

### When is the best time to schedule gutter cleaning?
Schedule gutter cleaning in late October or November — after the leaves drop but before Sacramento's rainy season begins in earnest. Booking early in the season gives you better availability than waiting until December when everyone remembers the gutters.
